data.title: Six humanoid robots run Chinese store for 24 hours, two fail assessment
data.description: Six AGIBOT G2 humanoid robots completed 1,730 tasks in a 24-hour Shanghai store trial, but only four passed the final assessment.
data.author: Kaif Shaikh
data.keywords: Agibot, Artificial intelligence, China, Embodied AI, G2 robot, Humanoid robots, retail automation, robot assistants, Robotics, Service Robots
